---

**07/05/2025 10:30 – SB**
Client meeting at their offices. Attendees: project sponsor, estates manager, and the client's project manager. I presented the revised programme for the fit-out phase – the client has accepted the programme with no changes. The snag list was reviewed – the client has confirmed the remaining items are acceptable and will be signed off once complete. The overlap option was discussed – the client has confirmed they want to proceed and will provide the start date by Friday. I have updated the open items list – the overlap item remains live, and the snag list item has been marked as accepted.

---

**07/05/2025 16:20 – JT**
Site visit after the client meeting. Groundworks have finished the slab pour on the west side – it is curing well. The cladding contractor has completed the eleventh bay on the north elevation – only two bays left. The scaffolders have taken down the north scaffold as far as the third bay. I have updated the programme – we remain on track for the end of the structural phase.
